stories.headline: 'Painful' years ahead, think tanks warn, as living standards set to fall
stories.description: Budget forecasts show growth in living standards grinding almost to a halt.

stories.headline: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
stories.description: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

stories.headline: Airbnb commits $500 million for its philanthropic arm to expand emergency stays
stories.description: Airbnb is dedicating over $500M to expand temporary housing for medical travelers and survivors.

stories.headline: Damascus, Amman contradict each other on attack that killed civilians
stories.description: Analysts say accountability is needed to quell public outrage over killing of family in southern Syria.

stories.headline: Fighting rages near Yemen’s Taiz as UN urges humanitarian access
stories.description: Fighting has forced more than 281,000 people from their homes in Yemen since the beginning of August, the UN said.
